Tome Foundational Treatment is a once-weekly skin renewal treatment powered by the Company’s Bioneedle technology and is designed to improve the appearance of skin tone, texture, fine lines, and dark spots. ● Announced positive topline results from cosmetic clinical study of Tome Foundational Treatment.
